description: Firing schedule for Yoxter Range and dry training area (YRDTA).

attachments.title: Yoxter Range and Dry Training Area firing times April 2026

details.body:
Yoxter range involves live firing with rifles as well as dry training, which is the practice of blank ammunition, pyrotechnics, vehicles and helicopters.

Do not enter the danger area when the range is in use, this is a danger to life. Learn more about accessing MOD training areas safely.
